channel.title: Arati U. Kamat — Publications
channel.description: Working papers and preprints by Arati U. Kamat.

item.title: Hour-Aware Memecoin Trading: Time-of-Day Effects in On-Chain Liquidity
item.description: Trading memecoins at different hours of the day gives very different outcomes. We show that avoiding the 9 worst hours preserves most of the profit while cutting risk in half.

item.title: Post-Rejection Counterfactual Sampling for Algorithmic Trading Filter Evaluation
item.description: How do you know your trading filter is rejecting bad trades, not good ones? We track what happens after each rejection to measure the miss-rate honestly.

item.title: Outcome-Classified Precision Auditing of Filter Rules in Algorithmic DEX Trading: Evidence from 2,400 Rejection Events
item.description: We measured how often our trading filter is right vs. wrong across 2,400 rejection events: for every 1 good trade blocked, the filters prevented approximately 15 losing trades. Every individual filter rule is net positive.
